text: {"lessons":["Selling positions just because they are up can cut off further gains; I should decide based on the investment outlook and my overall plan, not each stock’s separate gain or loss.","I should not hold a losing position merely to avoid admitting a mistake; reassess it using the same criteria as any other investment.","With months between check-ins, I should set a simple allocation and review plan so that doing nothing is deliberate rather than automatic."]}
